questions.qtext: Which of the following statements about regular languages are true?

options.text: Regular languages are closed under intersection.
Regular languages are closed under union.
Regular languages are closed under complement.
Regular languages are closed under Kleene operation.

questions.solution:
(a, b, c, d)
• Option (a) regular languages are closed under intersection.
• Option (b) regular languages are closed under union.
• Option (c) regular languages are closed under complement.
• Option (d) regular languages are closed under Kleene operation.
